author: sbein
body:
Add `fastSimPuppiJetRefineNN_Run2024_UnitaryShapeBest150_20260918.onnx`, trained
on private Run 2024 T1tttt FastSim/FullSim jet triplets. The 2022-trained payload
is retained unchanged.

The export uses the existing 12-input/9-output interface, dynamic batch,
ONNX opset 11 and IR 6. SHA-256:
`5b08adc94b3b7addb5674ee8c3da9adf3b6a149f1bbfdd862c929ee270927867`.
PyTorch/ONNX checks cover real jets, batch sizes and boundary inputs.

Validation: [native triplets](https://www.desy.de/~beinsam/FastSim/Refinement/FastPerfekt_UnitaryShapeBest150_20260918/index.html),
[200k ttbar](https://www.desy.de/~beinsam/FastSim/Refinement/TTbarRun3PU2024_PairedMiniAODN200k_FixedLinks_UnitaryShapeBest150_GenPt10Mask_20260921/index.html),
[T1tttt](https://www.desy.de/~beinsam/FastSim/Refinement/T1ttttRun3PU2024_InclusiveN20k_FixedLinks_UnitaryShapeBest150_GenPt10Mask_20260918/index.html).
The ttbar FullSim reference is published NanoAOD; FastSim is private re-Nano
of published MiniAOD with the association fix and a gen-pT >=10 GeV mask.

The companion CMSSW change selects this payload for 2024 production: https://github.com/cms-sw/cmssw/pull/51943
title: Add unitary Run 2024 FastSim PUPPI jet refinement payload
